text: Average order value went up by 11000 BRL between 2017-10 and 2017-11. The largest contribution came from PR (6600 BRL). The second largest contribution came from RS (4400 BRL). Average order value is defined as: Revenue divided by delivered orders The figure comes from raw.orders, raw.order_payments; the logged cleaning steps are parse_dates, drop_exact_duplicates.
